send_intents.subject: Agent reliability at Cardinal
send_intents.body:
Hi Cardinal team,

Your Founding Engineer role connects two hard problems: orchestrating outbound agents across sender accounts and keeping multi-tenant permissions understandable in the product. I like that the engineering includes both the workflow engine and the UI people actually use.

I built Captor to enforce per-call LLM budgets, policies, and traces, and at Stride AI I shipped React features and a shared authentication service across apps. I'd enjoy owning the messy boundaries between agent execution and product experience.

I'm based in India and open to relocating; your YC listing mentions visa sponsorship. Could I show you a short walkthrough of the relevant work?

Devansh

I built Captor to put budgets, tool policies, and traces around LLM calls, and at Stride AI I shipped backend APIs and production tests. I haven't worked professionally on trading infrastructure, but I care about reliable agent execution and measurable failure modes.
